venue_analysis.downtown_wren_house: Everything has meat or fish. Vegetarian deal-breaker for Mina: 0 stars.

notes: Every decoy fails exactly one constraint, which makes the puzzle clean and fair: a full read of each card is required.
Cyrus's peanut allergy is indirect (emergency pen + satay) and Roxy confirms it, so it is findable without the clue field. Good.

Mina's vegetarianism is never stated outright; it is inferred from 'zero meat' sushi day. Fair, but the softest clue in the chat. Linden Corner's review says the reviewer 'went meat-free' and works through the board rather than stating the board is fully meatless; it reads as a broad meat-free menu, which matches the 'whole section' standard.
Roxy's dairy clue is the clearest (Mina names milk, butter, cheese directly).
No budget is stated; all five venues are $ so this is not an issue.
Slate Window's peanut trap is fairly obvious (satay in the very first review) given Cyrus's satay line.
